YOUR PEACE OF MIND

Cookies & preferences

A small amount of useful memory. No advertising trackers.

Last updated October 6, 2026 · FirstLane app & website
ON THIS PAGE1. Website preferences2. Security on forms3. Leaving this website4. Your controls
No cookie wall. No advertising pixels.

This website does not set analytics or advertising cookies. You can browse the product and legal pages without accepting marketing tracking.

1. Website preferences

When you pause website animations, FirstLane stores a small preference called firstlane.motion in your browser’s local storage. This stays on your device until you change it or clear site data. It is not used to recognise you on other websites or to build an advertising profile.

Your device’s reduced-motion setting is respected automatically. You can also use the “Pause animations” control at the bottom of any page.

2. Security on forms

The support and account-deletion forms use Cloudflare Turnstile to limit abuse. When you interact with a protected form, Turnstile processes technical security signals. This website does not enable Turnstile’s optional pre-clearance cookie.

Temporary account-deletion authentication is held in memory for the current page. We do not save your verification code or account access token in cookies or local storage. Closing or reloading the page clears that in-memory flow. The authentication provider may retain limited security logs.

3. Leaving this website

App Store, Google Play and other external pages have their own privacy and cookie practices. Opening those pages does not give this website access to their cookies or your payment information.

4. Your controls

You can clear site data or block storage in your browser. The website remains readable when local storage is unavailable; your animation preference may no longer persist between visits. See the Privacy policy for other data practices, or Contact our privacy team.

Questions about this page? Contact FirstLane support
